scientific_claim: On the frozen immutable real UTF-8 prose/code split, Wingless formed the full fixed 512-entry level-1 and 128-entry level-2 hierarchy without tokenization or capacity growth, but the second level did not generalize sufficiently to fresh files: minimum level-2 coverage was 0.0007606, level-2-covered accuracy gain was zero, and hierarchical bits-per-byte was 0.0274 worse than level-1-only on the worst held-out file. This is a valid negative for the tested adjacent-two-selected-motif hierarchy, not a negative against the already-supported real-byte level-1 motif layer.
preservation: WLM-LM-REAL-UTF8-BYTE-PILOT-R2 remains supported. Do not retune R3 capacities, occurrence thresholds, scoring, smoothing, or corpus post hoc.
next_question: Use the supported real UTF-8 level-1 motif substrate as the target of a frozen real-workload degradation/monitor/retain-revert maintenance test; separately attribute why second-level real-byte compounds fail cross-file support before proposing a new hierarchy.
scope: immutable repo-owned real UTF-8 prose/code corpus; not open-domain language competence
